/* DailyLoginMapper.selectDailyUserForLogin */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.USER_ID AS userId , A.USER_NM AS userNm , A.USER_PW AS userPw , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , B.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus , A.WORK_EXPIRE_DATE AS workExpireDate , A.WITHDRAWAL_DATE AS withdrawalDate , A.PWD_LOCK_YN AS pwdLockYn , A.PWD_FAIL_CNT AS pwdFailCnt , A.PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME AS pwdLockExpireDtime FROM TB_DAILY_USER A INNER JOIN TB_SITE B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD ) WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}
mapper.update: /* DailyLoginMapper.updateDailyUserPwdUnlock */ UPDATE TB_DAILY_USER SET PWD_LOCK_YN = 'N' , PWD_FAIL_CNT = 0 , PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME = NULL , UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM' , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD = #{userCd} AND PWD_LOCK_YN = 'Y' AND PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME IS NOT NULL AND PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME <= NOW()

/* DailyLoginMapper.updateDailyUserPwdFail */ UPDATE TB_DAILY_USER SET PWD_FAIL_CNT = PWD_FAIL_CNT + 1, PWD_LOCK_YN = CASE WHEN PWD_FAIL_CNT + 1 >= #{pwdFailMaxCnt} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME = CASE WHEN PWD_FAIL_CNT + 1 >= #{pwdFailMaxCnt} THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{lockDurationMinutes} MINUTE) ELSE NULL END, UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD = #{userCd}
